title: ICE: Calendar Year 2025 Obligations by Funding Source and Object Class
footer_text:
Notes: Calendar-year 2025 obligations are derived from cumulative quarter-end File B snapshots: Mar. 31, 2025 minus Dec. 31, 2024; Jun. 30 minus Mar. 31; Sep. 30 minus Jun. 30; plus Dec. 31, 2025.
"Personnel expenses" groups pay and benefit categories. "All Other Activities" groups smaller categories omitted from the chart. Source: USAspending.gov File B.
